title: Cash Pickup Reactivated Window: Days by Principal Collected
content:
**Product sheet: reactivated Cash Pickup pickups.** A reactivated pickup receives extra days according to the principal collected on the transfer. That is the total of the funds received for the transfer, as recorded on its money movements.

| Principal collected on the transfer (USD) | Days added to the reactivated window |
|---|---|
| at least 1000.00 | 2 |
| at least 500.00 but less than 1000.00 | 1 |
| less than 500.00 | none |

The days are whole calendar days and move the last day of collection later.

## Edges of the bands (hypothetical principals)

| Principal collected | Days |
|---|---|
| 499.99 | none |
| 500.00 | 1 |
| 999.99 | 1 |
| 1000.00 | 2 |
